concerns.text: FR-003 mandates implementation of CUSUM procedures. T021 and its re-implementation T070 are marked [ ] (incomplete). The task list fails to deliver the required artifact (`data/results/cusum_predictions.csv`), leaving a core functional requirement unimplemented.

FR-007 and SC-004 require a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds to report false-positive/negative rates. T026b is marked [ ] (incomplete) with no output artifact (`data/results/sensitivity_analysis.json`), failing to deliver a required success criterion.

User Story 3 requires generating visual evidence (correlation matrices, method comparisons) to support detectability analysis. T028 and T029 are marked [ ] (incomplete) with missing figure artifacts (`fig1_timeseries.png`, `fig2_method_comparison.png`), preventing verification of the research outcome.

FR-008 requires framing findings as associational and avoiding causal claims. T030 (the `paper/results.md` generation task) is marked [ ] (incomplete), meaning the final artifact containing these mandatory framing constraints cannot be verified.

Plan Complexity Tracking and Constitution Principle VI mandate Sparse Variational Inference with ELBO stability checks and discarding non-converged runs. T016 and T065 are marked [ ] (incomplete), leaving the critical performance constraint (7GB limit) and constitutional convergence logic unverified.

Plan.md defines a strict `code/` prefix for all source files. T032 (path verification) is marked [ ] (incomplete) with no evidence that the repository conforms to this structure, risking violation of the Single Source of Truth and reproducibility principles.

T023 (Baseline Integration Verification) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without verified logs proving T020-T022 outputs are compatible with T026a, the evaluation pipeline integrity is unverified, risking silent data format mismatches.

Plan.md requires pinned versions and style consistency. T061 (Code Style Enforcement) is marked [ ] (incomplete) with a missing `ruff.toml` artifact, violating the plan's requirement for reproducibility before the research review gate.
